newsitem.title: USA: United Retail Group Dec sales $43.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: United Retail Group Dec sales $43.5 mln.

text.p: United Retail Group Inc said Thursday that total sales for the fiscal month ended January 4, 1997 were $43.5 million compared to $47.5 million in December 1995, an 8 percent decrease.
Comparable store sales for the four weeks ended Dec. 28, 1996 declined 4 percent, the company said.
Comparable store sales for the fiscal month ended Jan. 4, 1997 declined 9 percent, the company said.
Merchandise margins for the month were substantially higher than last year's, the company said. Average inventory levels, at month end, were lower than last year's levels, the company said.
Total sales for the fiscal quarter-to-date were $73.2 million compared to $77.7 million in the comparable period in the previous year, a 6 percent decrease, the company said.
Comparable store sales for the quarter-to-date declined 7 percent, the company said.
Total sales for the fiscal year-to-date were $342.5 million compared to $344.3 million in the comparable period in the previous year, the company said.
Comparable store sales for the year-to-date declined 4 percent, the company said.
